capture_method: Next bounded cook/import shader phase will be launched under a Job Object (job_supervision.spawn_in_job) with 30s polling of member_pids + per-worker CPU delta; any disappearance with outstanding shader jobs records WORKER_TERMINATED_UNEXPECTEDLY with worker index, last PID, last CPU, queue depth, and parent state. Exit codes of (already-dead) workers are unrecoverable retroactively -- hence PENDING, not backfilled.
ue_supervision_model: UE4.26 ShaderCompilingManager tracks workers internally and relaunches missing ones only at job-submission boundaries; a mid-batch full disappearance leaves the cooker waiting on jobs nobody owns (observed M_Fabric_Master retry storm). Engine does not record per-worker exit codes anywhere queryable.
